response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication prescribed as part of treatment for an injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during the trip. Clause A4.1 explicitly covers the cost of medications prescribed by a doctor for acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, intentional, or related to alcohol, drugs, or extreme sports, which would trigger exclusions under other clauses."}
